'''Humbug''' is a [[Rock]] type [[DPS]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves into [[Humbeetle]] at 6 bronze stars.

==Overview==
Current Description: "To the confusion of other Tatari, Humbug favors a strange dark substance, supposedly carrying the sweetness of sunshine, grass, and time itself."

Humbug is a purple rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
A small [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dung_beetle dung beetle]-like creature with large eyes. Its body is brown, its wings are dark brown, and the horn between its eyes is yellow-orange. It also stands on a yellow-orange ball that has a swirl marking on it.

Humbug's [[Tatari#Glitter Tataris|Glitter]] form changes its wings to dark teal and its ball becomes turquoise.

== Evolution Trial ==
Humbug's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 6 bronze stars/19 copies. To evolve it into [[Humbeetle]] you need to complete the following task:
* Land 10 pinballs in the [[Pinball|Star Slot]]. Easy peasy!

== Trivia ==
* Prior to the update on 03/11/2026, its bio description said: "A Humbug who's got no humbug. Get it?! Oh, my boss is going to cut my salary for these bad dad jokes."
* Prior to the update on 05/12/2026, its bio description said: "Stares at the same spot for an entire day, though no one can tell what Humbug's watching."
